annotation.speech2: The graph of a function with rectangles approximating the area.

The first rectangle has height zero; it's top left corner touches the curve at the origin. The second rectangle has height about 0.75. Only it's top left corner touches the curve; the rest of it is below the curve. The third rectangle has height about 0.75. Only it's top right corner touches the curve; the rest of it is below the curve. The fourth rectangle has height 0 touching the curve at its top right corner.
From the left the graph climbs from the origin to y=1 at x=1. It then descends symmetric to its climb.
